summary.en: Streaming fragments scenes; guitar records still chart via psych, post-punk, and festival indie.
summary.zh: 流媒体打碎场景；迷幻、后朋克与音乐节 Indie 仍让吉他唱片上榜。

sound.en: Bedroom psych production, festival PA scale, post-punk reportage vocals
sound.zh: 卧室迷幻制作、音乐节 PA 尺度、后朋克纪实人声

body.en:
Playlists replace record-store clerks; guitar albums still reach headphones via Bandcamp, Spotify, and festival bills. Tame Impala builds solo psych with drum machines and layered guitars. Fontaines D.C. show post-punk cadence still carries city reportage. Bands after Radiohead inherit permission to mutate form without quitting guitars.

Modern rock here is not nostalgia cosplay. It tracks how the format adapts to streaming economics while drums and riffs still lead the mix.
body.zh:
播放列表取代唱片店店员；吉他专辑仍经 Bandcamp、Spotify 与音乐节进入耳机。Tame Impala 用鼓机与叠层吉他做独奏迷幻。Fontaines D.C. 证明后朋克节奏仍能运载城市纪实。Radiohead 之后的乐队继承了改变曲式、不放弃吉他的许可。

本站的当代摇滚不是复古扮演。它追踪格式如何适应流媒体经济，同时鼓与 Riff 仍主导混音。
